id.label: ID
id.helper: A unique identifier for an invoice.

invoice.label: Invoice date
invoice.helper: The date on which the invoice was issued. The payment period starts from then.

due.label: Payable until
due.helper: The date of the payment deadline. The invoice must be paid by then.

payment.label: Paid on
payment.helper: The date on which the invoice was paid.

title.label: Subject
title.helper: A short description of what it is about.

text.label: Text
text.helper: An identifier for the invoice item.

amount.label: Invoice amount
amount.helper: Total amount on the invoice across all items.

fix.label: Fixed amount
fix.description: A fixed amount, independent of a quantity.

hours.label: Hours
hours.description: Number of hours times hourly rate.

days.label: Days
days.description: Number of days times daily rate.

deduction.label: Deduction
deduction.description: A deduction from the invoice amount.

rebate.label: Discount
rebate.description: A discount on the invoice amount.

srvFee.label: SRV fee
srvFee.description: Fee for the Swiss Rowing Association.

unitPrice.label: Unit price
unitPrice.helper: The price of a single item.

accountId.label: Account number
accountId.helper: The unique number of an account.

header.label: Header
header.helper: Text displayed above the invoice items on the invoice.

footer.label: Footer
footer.helper: Text displayed below the invoice items on the invoice.

from.label: Valid from
from.helper: The invoice is valid from this date.

to.label: Valid until
to.helper: The invoice is valid until this date.

create.label: Add invoice
create.error: The invoice could not be created.

delete.label: Delete invoice
delete.confirm: Should the invoice really be deleted ?
delete.error: The invoice could not be deleted.

update.label: Edit invoice
update.error: The invoice could not be changed.

view.label: Show invoice details
view.pdf_error: The invoice could not be loaded as a PDF. Please try again later.
view.pdf_missing: There is no PDF for this invoice yet.

paymentConfirmation.label: Create payment confirmation
paymentConfirmation.noAddress: There is no postal address for this invoice. A payment confirmation needs an address.
paymentConfirmation.error: The payment confirmation could not be created. Please try again later.

readonly.banner: This list is read-only. The accounts receivable are managed in Bexio.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: The invoice is a draft and has not been sent yet.

pending.label: Open
pending.description: The invoice has been sent and is not yet paid.

overdue.label: Overdue
overdue.description: The payment deadline has passed, the invoice is overdue.

error.tooMany: An invoice can have at most 100 items.
error.name: Give the item a description.
error.amount: The amount must be greater than 0.

issue.label: Issue invoice
issue.confirm: The invoice now gets its number and is booked. After that you can no longer change it.
issue.error: The invoice could not be issued.

refusal.no-positions: The invoice has no items yet. Add at least one item first.
refusal.position-without-account: At least one item has no revenue account. Choose an account for every item.
refusal.invalid-amount: At least one item has no valid amount. Please check the amounts.
refusal.total-not-positive: The invoice total must be greater than 0.
refusal.no-receivables-account: The accounting settings have no receivables account yet. Please add it there.
refusal.no-receiver: The invoice has no recipient yet. Choose who it goes to first.
refusal.no-invoice-date: The invoice has no invoice date yet.
refusal.no-invoice-template: The accounting settings have no invoice template yet. Please add it there.
refusal.account-invalid: One of the accounts cannot be booked on. Choose an account without sub-accounts for every item.
refusal.period-locked: The accounting period of the invoice date is closed. Choose another date or have the period reopened.
refusal.state-changed: The invoice was changed in the meantime. Please try again.
refusal.not-a-draft: This invoice is no longer a draft and can no longer be changed.
refusal.not-found: This invoice no longer exists. Perhaps it was deleted.
refusal.bexio-backend: These books are kept in bexio. You create invoices there.
refusal.no-accounting-config: These books have no settings yet. Please set them up first.
refusal.foreign-accounting-tenant: These books do not belong to your club.
refusal.too-many-positions: An invoice can have at most 100 items.
refusal.inconsistent-state: Something went wrong while issuing. Please try again.
